extracted.name: Easy Curry Dip
extracted.description: This quick and easy curry dip combines mayo, ketchup, and curry powder for a creamy, flavorful appetizer perfect for crudités, chips, or sandwiches.
instruction_lines: Mix mayonnaise, ketchup, curry powder, Worcestershire sauce, and white pepper together in a small bowl until smooth and well combined.
